briefings.title: U.S. Trade Rep. Jamieson Greer on failed U.S.-Canada trade talks: 'They wanted more'
briefings.tldr: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer stated that recent trade talks with Canada collapsed because Canadian officials "wanted more" concessions despite the U.S. offering the world's most preferential market access.

briefings.title: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer testifies on Trump's trade policy agenda — 7/22/2026
briefings.tldr: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer testified before the Senate Finance Committee on the Trump administration's 2026 trade policy agenda, defending the use of targeted tariffs and reciprocal trade agreements to drive domestic re-industrialization, while bipartisan senators pushed back on rising consumer costs, trade disruptions, and agricultural strain.

briefings.title: U.S. Trade Rep. Jamieson Greer: 'Expect action soon' on sweeping new tariffs
briefings.tldr: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer defended the administration's new 50% tariffs on specific Canadian goods as a necessary response to Canadian trade retaliation and signaled that sweeping new global actions regarding forced labor and AI competition are imminent.

briefings.title: This Week with George Stephanopoulos Full Broadcast - Sunday, May 17, 2026
briefings.tldr: President Trump is finalizing a controversial $1.776 billion taxpayer-funded settlement—effectively a "Truth and Justice" slush fund—to compensate political allies, while leveraging Taiwan arms sales as trade chips and facing criticism for prioritizing D.C. "vanity projects" over domestic economic relief.

briefings.title: Greer on EU Complying With Trade Deal, Trump to China
briefings.tldr: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer warns that the European Union is "past due" on fulfilling its commitments under the Turnberry trade agreement, signaling potential tariff escalations if the EU fails to remove industrial tariffs and provide regulatory flexibility.

briefings.title: FULL HEARING: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer Grilled On Trump's Tariffs, Trade Policies
briefings.tldr: United States Trade Representative Jamieson Greer defended a $95 million FY2027 budget request, arguing that the administration’s "reciprocal" tariff policy is successfully reducing trade deficits and fueling a manufacturing renaissance, while critics characterized the policies as an illegal and "chaotic" burden that has cost the average American household $1,700 annually.

briefings.title: CHINA WARNS TRUMP: Trade probe risks major economic fallout
briefings.tldr: The Trump administration is resetting the U.S.-China economic relationship through a proposed "Board of Trade" and broad Section 301 investigations into global excess capacity and forced labor, while reporting a 30% drop in the trade deficit with China over the past year.

briefings.title: GLOBAL SHIFT: Trump targets China's dominance with 'critical' move
briefings.tldr: The U.S. is executing a "whole-of-government" strategy to break China’s dominance in critical minerals while transitioning from multilateral trade agreements to high-stakes bilateral deals aimed at reducing the trade deficit and boosting domestic manufacturing.
